title: Seat protocol v1: shared definitions
description: Definitions reused by every kind. Unknown fields are always allowed and ignored by readers (additionalProperties is never false); extension fields should be named x-<ns>.<name>.

cursor.description: Opaque, server-issued stream position. Clients store it and send it back; they never parse or compare it.

extensionKind.description: Namespaced extension kind, for example x-acme.approval.

input.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12, boolean schemas included) describing the form the UI draws for this action. Absent: the action takes no input.

danger.description: True: the UI asks for confirmation before sending.

entity.description: Fields every kind carries: a stable id and the time of its last change; title, summary and actions let any UI render an unknown kind as a generic card.
